thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected for enterprise tenant 'ValenciaCorp' (dedicated pool vc-west-1) in us-west-2. Error rate spiked to 18% over 5m window. Potential networking flakiness between load balancer and inference nodes. Paging oncall.

eline: I'm on it, grabbing logs and health checks. can someone confirm if this is isolated to vc-west-1?

alex: I see same spike in metrics. Dedicated pool vc-west-1 showing node flaps and a handful of pods OOMKilled last 10m. Not seeing broader platform impact yet.

maria: ValenciaCorp's app tier is still serving, but model responses are timing out ~2-3s more often. Customer-facing latency alerts firing. cs pinged (june-cs).

june-cs: Received customer message — they're seeing intermittent 504s. Asking for ETA and mitigation. They've requested a regional shift if necessary.

samir: Adding ops-sre to triage. suggest warm failover to vc-east-1 (us-east-1) while we investigate. We have reserved warm capacity for ValenciaCorp in east.

ops-sre: Agreed. Plan: 1) Lower DNS TTL for ValenciaCorp CNAME to 30s (if not already). 2) Warm up east pool (start pods, pre-warm KV caches). 3) Shift traffic with weighted routing canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. 4) Rollback plan ready.

eline: I'm starting step 1/health checks now. Pasting current LB logs snippet:

```
[us-west-2-lb] 2026-03-15T01:12:13Z backend=vc-node-7 status=502 backend-conns=0 error=connection-reset
[us-west-2-lb] 2026-03-15T01:12:45Z backend=vc-node-3 status=503 backend-conns=2 reason=oom_kill
```

alex: Node flapping looks like memory pressure + occasional kernel OOM. Might be model cache growth after recent traffic pattern change. Were there any model swaps or quantization changes?

maria: No model swaps in the last 24h for ValenciaCorp. Last config push was 2 days ago (small batching tweak).

samir: While you confirm root cause, let's execute failover. @dns-admin can you lower TTL for valencia.example.com to 30s? Current TTL is 300.

dns-admin: Ack. Changing TTL to 30s now. DNS change pushed — propagation should be immediate for new queries.

deploy-bot: :gear: Initiating warm pool spin-up in us-east-1 (vc-east-1-reserved). Requested instances: 6 g4dn-like. Estimated warm up 6m. Track: deploy/rollup/1853004444

eline: Warming started. Kicking off healthcheck script against warmed endpoints.

alex: Checking for stateful dependencies — KV caches and Redis in tenant VPC: their read-replica is available in east, but replication lag ~3s, acceptable. Make sure cache priming scripts run after pods up.

samir: I'll trigger cache-priming job as soon as pods report ready. Command:

```
kubectl -n valencia exec -it cache-warm -- ./prime.sh --targets=vc-east-*
```

ops-sre: Starting traffic shift canary to 10% now via weighted routing in our traffic-router: `rioute set-weight valencia 10 --region us-east-1`. Monitoring request success and latencies for 5m.

line: small typo: @ops-sre i meant eline.

eline: :white_check_mark: Canary 10% -> us-east in progress. Initial success: success_rate 99.2% on canary, avg latency +50ms. us-west still degraded.

june-cs: Message to customer: "We're initiating controlled traffic shift to our warm region and will update in ~15 mins. Expect minimal interruption during cutover"

maria: After 10m telemetry looks good on canary. Increasing to 50%. ops-sre to proceed?

ops-sre: Increasing to 50% now. Note: we have model variant fallback enabled: if memory creep persists on west, west will fallback to smaller quantized model to keep latency but at reduced quality. We'll avoid that while we're shifting traffic.

dns-admin: Reminder: TTL lowered to 30s — cutover will be quick for clients that re-resolve. If customer has long-lived connections they might need a restart. June-cs to note.

june-cs: Noted; sending note to ValenciaCorp support channel advising restart for a subset of persistent clients.

samir: 50% shift stable for 7m. No errors on east. Proceeding to 100% now.

eline: 100% traffic is now routed to us-east. Observability: overall error rate back to baseline (0.4%), latency normalized. Marking mitigation succeeded.

alex: Kicking off remediation for us-west nodes: collecting heap profiles, core dumps, and scaling nodes down one at a time for debug. Suspect a memory leak in the batching layer.

ops-sre: We're keeping east warm for 2 hours per runbook. If west recovers earlier, we'll do a controlled backfill with canary and small batches.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Warm pool successfully warmed and traffic routed. Warm/evacuation job id: deploy/rollup/1853004444-complete

eline: Informing customer that we've shifted them to us-east to prevent impact, their traffic is stable. CS sent update and offered a 1:1 with SRE for details.

june-cs: Customer replied: "Thanks, stable now. Please keep us posted on root cause and ETA to restore our west region."

samir: We'll investigate root cause and prepare postmortem. Assigning action items: Alex - heap/profile analysis; Eline - confirm backfill runbook and rollback criteria; Ops-sre - retention of warm capacity and cost estimate; June-cs - customer comms record.

alex: Found suspicious allocation pattern in batcher: increased during large-batch windows at 00:58-01:05UTC. I'll open a dedicated issue with traces.

eline: Oncall handoff at 04:00UTC -> @samir will take over. I'll leave runbook notes in the incident doc.

samir: Taking it. If anything regresses we re-route back to west only after signature tests.

ops-sre: Post-incident actions:
- Create postmortem ticket (sev: high, customer-impact: yes)
- Add memory limits to batcher sidecar and safer OOM handling
- Autoscale policy review for dedicated pools
- Runbook DR test for ValenciaCorp failover

june-cs: Customer asked for timeline for backfill to west. Recommend we aim to restore by EOD with patch, otherwise keep east as primary until fix shipped.

eline: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate with Alex on a fix timeline.

incident-bot: Incident marked as MITIGATED by eline at 2026-03-15T04:20:44Z. Severity downgraded. Please file postmortem within 72h.

samir: Thanks team. Good coordination. Closing channel in 2h after handoff.

maria: Adding note: tag these logs with `valencia-west-evac-1853004444` for easier traceability.

alex: Created issue: INF-4482 "batcher memory spike during high batch windows" and attached heapdump.

eline: Handoff complete. Oncall -> samir.

june-cs: Customer update sent: "We have shifted your traffic to us-east as a temporary measure. SRE is investigating root cause; we'll update within 24h." :thumbsup:

ops-sre: Leaving monitoring alerts in adjusted mode: suppress duplicate pager for next 3h.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents log."
